reason: Reveals complexity only when needed, which concerns what the person must take in and choose; the avoid list is about toggles and settings panels, so it is screen wording.
Asks whether a control is recognisable as one and whether its affordance can be relied on; it has bound diagnostics that do not read the medium.

Acknowledgement within 100ms and no fake success cover sensing state, knowing an act landed, and reliance on what is shown; the wording is screen-bound (progress bar, highlight) and there are no diagnostics.
Completion status and next-step guidance tell the person where they are and that the act finished; the wording ('bottom of the current view') is screen wording.
Back path and an Exit are about leaving and going back; the bound MISSING_CANCEL diagnostic does not look at the medium.
Remembered and pre-filled values save choosing and re-entering; the title, avoid and solution carry no real screen wording and there are no diagnostics.
An error message must say what is required and give a verb that fixes it, so the person can recover; the avoid list names red text, which is screen wording.
Fewer knobs and strong defaults reduce what the person must choose; the wording names no screen element.
Focus isolation sets what the person can choose and shows that the rest waits, and Esc always exits; the bound TRAPPED_FLOW diagnostic does not read the medium, so step 2 puts it on any.
Disabling the background restricts choices to the focus, and Esc is the guaranteed way out; the bound TRAPPED_FLOW diagnostic does not read the medium.

Structure, labels and non-interrupting announcements let people who cannot see locate and read the interface; the rule states the web markup is only a realisation and asks for the same structure in any medium.
A document is read and viewed as a destination with chrome receding; the rule names print and PDF and is also written for the screen.
Video and audio must not autoplay and need captions or transcripts so the content can be understood; the rule names video and audio.
One quiet progress indication tells the person that a bulk act is happening and finished; the wording (progress bar, notifications, blocking UI) is screen wording.
A fixed document anatomy lets readers navigate and read it; the rule names print formatting and is also written for the screen.
Instant undo replaces confirmation dialogs after an act; the bound undo diagnostics do not read the medium.
State the system knows must be perceivable in the surface's own medium and explained in plain words; the bound diagnostics do not read the medium.
A committing act must name its actor and a control must mean the same thing everywhere, so authority can be relied on; the bound diagnostics do not read the medium.
The result of a critical action must stay long enough to be registered; the avoid list names transitions 'the eye cannot follow', which is visual wording, and there are no diagnostics.

A list opens pre-filtered to the task's slice, which narrows the person's choices and says what they are looking at; the wording (views, lists, filters) is screen wording and there are no diagnostics.
An agent is an actor under the same norms and audit trail as a human, so reliance on who acts is the concern; the wording names no screen element.
A model's output is a reviewable, dismissible proposal committed only by a named authority; the bound PROPOSAL_COMMITS diagnostic does not read the medium.
Machine-made content must be visibly marked, which is perceivable state that supports reliance on what the interface says; the wording is medium-free.
Refusals state the circumstance without blame and offer a next step, which concerns how messages read and how far the system can be relied on; the wording is medium-free.
Proactive interventions fire only from declared triggers, so attention is spent only where earned and the assistant stays reliable; the wording is medium-free.
Names machines and agents as readers: structure, anchors and declared intents so an agent can read and operate the interface.
Motion is allowed only when it reports a change the person might miss, which concerns sensing state; the bound diagnostics do not read the medium.
Data colour split into five fixed statuses and one neutral style lets the person sense state and read what a colour means; the bound UNKNOWN_SIGNAL diagnostic does not read the medium.
A widget's form must show its role, so the person can tell an indicator from an action; the bound ROLE_ACTS_WITHOUT_CONSEQUENCE diagnostic does not read the medium.
Every string lives in a per-language dictionary so the interface reads in the operator's language; the wording names no medium.
A reading surface has a section budget and no walls of text so it can be read and scanned; the wording (page, sections, paragraphs) is screen wording and there are no diagnostics.
Names sound and earcons as a channel that may corroborate but not be the acknowledgement of an act.
Every element must trace to an intent the person is performing, so none is mistaken for a choice or competes with what matters; the bound INTENT_ORPHAN diagnostic does not read the medium.
